title: Amazon Attrition Lens
why: Amazon's fulfillment and delivery workforce has well-documented high turnover, which drives up hiring and training cost and disrupts sites. This tool finds which conditions cause exits and what to change first.
problem: Employee turnover has increased significantly, creating recruitment costs and operational disruption. Develop an AI system that integrates employee performance, workload, compensation, absenteeism, overtime, engagement and training data to identify organizational factors associated with attrition and recommend evidence-based retention interventions.
data_note: 2,400 associates across 4 job families and 48 managers, 12 months of HR records (sample data).

steps.detail: Performance, workload, pay, absence, overtime, engagement, training
Overtime level, pay gap to market, months since promotion
Propensity score matching: does heavy overtime cause exits?
Attrition by manager vs company rate
Simulate policy changes with the model

questions: Is overtime really causing people to quit?
Is the pay correction worth its cost?
Write a retention plan for the night shift
author: K Mohan Kumar
